scope: Independent read-only review of Faraday-authored NestedFrameOccurrence against actual Cert selection. Reviewer authored Cert/Args dependencies; their separate independent reviews remain required.
checks: XiAt.here introduces only literal Xi requests with exact original fuel, input args and XiResult certificate, including an actually invoked zero-fuel Xi. Transparent wrappers and X continuations never introduce an extra frame.

Constructor coverage mirrors every recursive Cert edge: X step-error child, X next child and tail, halt/revert child, Xi body, Theta code body, Lambda selected init and actual StepChild. No recursive edge is omitted.

Absent constructors for X zero/guard error, StepChild none, Theta precompile/zero and Lambda no-preimage/zero are correct because those branches invoke no Xi descendants. Collision-selected invalid init remains a lambdaInit branch and is traversable.

xNextChild carries the actual tail certificate and xNextTail carries the actual step certificate, fixing the full outer tree even while locating one branch. Step-error traversal retains selected descendants before propagated/caught errors and rollback.
StepChild traversal fixes the actual selected request with the graph equality; it cannot choose a different frame just because returned outputs match.
cert_top reconstructs the exact surrounding Cert. sound_top and sound_inner identify the literal outer and located-Xi outcomes without requiring success, commitment or matching outer/inner statuses.

frame_root is structural: child prefixes preserve a trailing false; tail prefixes require x_nonempty, preventing an X continuation from introducing an empty-root frame. Wrapper traversal preserves paths unchanged.

at_tree recovers an actual inner Xi certificate and embeds each occurrence by path concatenation into the same outer tree, using EventTree child/next membership lemmas. It does not substitute a separately chosen larger-fuel trace or compare only counts.
Ancestor/descendant local-event ownership can now consume frame_root together with existing owned_distinct; fixed-prefix injectivity alone is not assumed sufficient.
scope_limits: The constructors provide complete coverage of actual certificate traversal edges, but no explicit enumeration or theorem extracting a collection of all Xi frame occurrences is exported.

No uniqueness theorem for XiAt fuel/args/result at a fixed frame path is exported. A bound for any finite collection with distinct frame paths can still use frame_root and event transport without that theorem.
at_tree proves occurrence transport and actual inner certification, not a separate raw tree-node lookup equality. This is sufficient for an event-count injection consumer.
No global append-frame count, canonical contract identity, committed-storage accounting, protocol admission, external funding or block-history result is established by this module.
